channel.title: ApexForm Updates
channel.description: Sparkle feed for ApexForm (direct download builds).

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.11 (Public Beta 11)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 11

  • Squat counting: seated head and torso leans no longer count as reps
  • A bounce at the bottom of a deep squat no longer splits it into two reps
  • Depth is now logged relative to your shoulder span to tune counting for any camera distance

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.10 (Public Beta 10)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 10

  • Squat counting: continuous sets no longer collapse into one discarded rep when you don’t stand back to the exact same height
  • Settings now states the monthly/yearly price and that Pro renews until you cancel

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.9 (Public Beta 9)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 9

  • One referral credit per friend — extra Lemon webhooks no longer stack months
  • Friend invite code vs Activate token are clearly separate in Settings
  • Subscribe links hide once you’re already Pro

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.8 (Public Beta 8)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 8

  • Simpler friend invites — subscribe via the website so the discount applies with no code typing
  • Activation email opens ApexForm in one click
  • Invite binds automatically when you Activate Pro (no Save invite / receipt email)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.7 (Public Beta 7)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 7

  • On-screen posture card names what slipped (head, shoulders, chest) and stays until you sit back up
  • Settings › Cue as: Sound, On-screen card, or both — card-only is silent for shared offices
  • Clearer Invite a friend wording

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.6 (Public Beta 6)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 6

  • Pro checkout uses the live Lemon Squeezy store ($5/mo or $39/yr)
  • New installs get a 3-day full Pro trial, then limited free

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.5 (Public Beta 5)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 5

  • Personalized Desk Reset mix (onboarding questionnaire)
  • Desk Reset rename, launch at login, single-instance guard
  • Squat counting: no double-counts, better continuous/fast sets
  • Pace hints + encouragement; richer default break mix

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.4 (Public Beta 4)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 4

  • Lemon Squeezy Pro checkout live — $5/mo or $39/yr
  • APEXSUB subscription tokens + Settings Activate / expiry
  • Limited free after trial (not “free forever” full Pro)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.3 (Public Beta 3)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 3

  • Soft 10-day Pro trial, then free forever (Normal coaching + blinks)
  • Home/Office desk profiles (Pro)
  • Calmer Bio-Tax scheduling around standing work
  • Onboarding polish
  • HealthKit removed — unsupported on macOS Developer ID

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (Public Beta 2)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta 2

  • Hardened squat/twist counting (fewer freeloads, better leave-frame reps)
  • Bio-Tax return-settle after away; Escape dismisses by default
  • No slouch cues when screen locked or face off calibrated desk
  • Multi-person mute + Pause/Unpause fix
  • Public Sparkle updates feed (source stays private)

item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta (Public Beta)
item.description:
ApexForm Public Beta

  • Standing work detection + auto-start
  • Weekly summary dashboard
  • Squat counting hardening (multi-person frame)
  • Calibration coaching mute
